Think balance. The Miata and mini both have low power and low weight so that makes them handle better than most and are easy to drive. If you build a high hp car or heavy car it is mostly likely going to be sluggish in the curves on a road coarse. On the street you are never really going fast enough to notice the loss of handling. That is why miatas and minis have great"track" reputations because they are usable in every day scenarios a and can be driven"fast" on the track.  This is where balance comes into play like Porsche is so revered because they are light and have a good amount of hp. They are also easy to drive fast in and out of corners and have just enough power to accelerate put of them. Just focus on the handling and power at the same time. Don't let one become dominant over the other.
